title: Asian shares mostly decline after AI stocks lead a rebound on Wall Street
hook_text: Wall Street just rebounded on AI.
script:
Wall Street just rebounded on AI stocks.
Asian shares mostly declined right after that United States session.
South Korea markets dropped four percent during the trading hours.
Investors reacted to sudden capital shifts across global technology sectors.
Traders are watching US hardware demand to gauge tomorrow prices.
Will regional indexes bounce back from this drop?
